svg.title: npm
svg.desc: Third-party mark. Source: simple-icons/simple-icons, CC0 1.0. Post-processed for this system: rescaled from 24 to the round keyline 13 in an 18-unit box, scale corrected by 0.890 so measured ink coverage sits inside the set band, and flattened to one tone. NOT a member of the drawn icon set — see assets/icons/README.md and the .platform fence in components/components.css.
